bill_text.plain_text:
A bill for an act relating to environment; appropriating money to complete a regional Mississippi overpass multiuse trail bridge.

BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF MINNESOTA:

Section 1. APPROPRIATION; REGIONAL MISSISSIPPI OVERPASS MULTIUSE TRAIL BRIDGE.

$3,250,000 in fiscal year 2026 is appropriated from the environment and natural resources trust fund to the commissioner of administration for a grant to the city of Ramsey to complete a regional Mississippi overpass multiuse trail bridge.
